articles.headline: The Empyrean Strikes Back
articles.deck: Argent sat on eight points and waited for the end. It came, from a wormhole nobody was watching.
articles.byline: Filed from a galaxy far, far away

crawl.title: The Empyrean Strikes Back
text: It is a tense time for the galaxy. Seven factions stand within reach of victory, and every alliance is one betrayal away from collapse.
Entrenched behind a wall of warships, the ARGENT FLIGHT waits on eight points, certain that the throne of Mecatol Rex is already theirs.
Crushed by the relentless Naaz-Rokha and driven to the edge of the map, the EMPYREAN have not given up. In secret, they plot their return through the mysterious wormhole known as MALLICE....

articles.caption: Artist's impression: the Empyrean strike back through the Mallice wormhole, while Argent's wall looks the wrong way.
body: The galaxy was on a knife's edge. Seven factions stood within striking distance of victory, and for once nobody was out of the running. Every fleet movement mattered, every secret objective could decide the game, and every alliance was one betrayal away from collapse.

The *Argent Flight* played the Empire at the height of its power. On eight points, they parked their fleets around their home systems and waited for the galaxy to bow. Surely nothing could stop them now.
The Council sensed a disturbance and tried to intervene, but Argent's plans were so well hidden that even its wisest politicians could not work out what on earth they were up to.

Elsewhere, the *Xxcha Kingdom* learned the true meaning of suffering. Denied Leadership and strangled at the source, its grand ambitions shrank to watching others play the game it had hoped to control.

The *L1Z1X Mindnet* followed the doctrine of an imperial fleet admiral: shoot first, ask questions never. Fleets burned, borders shifted, and nobody could be sure who was next. Perhaps not even L1Z1X.
But the real story was unfolding in exile. Beaten by the relentless *Naaz-Rokha Alliance*, the *Empyrean* had been driven to the frozen edge of the map, like rebels hiding out on an ice planet.

There they found an unlikely ally in the *Mahact Gene-Sorcerers*. Like a certain smooth-talking administrator of a city in the clouds, Mahact made a deal it would come to regret, and cleared the path to Mallice. The route was open, and almost nobody saw what was coming.

body.quote: One moment, Argent had the game in the bag. The next, the Empyrean had won.

body: While Argent sat comfortably behind its wall, the Empyrean struck back. They slipped through Mallice like a battered freighter through an asteroid field, odds be damned, and took the game. There was no drawn-out endgame, no last-minute rescue at the negotiating table, and no time left for the Council to crack the plot.
The lesson for the galaxy: never count your victory points before someone steals a planet from another dimension. Argent may yet return. For now, the Empyrean rule the galaxy.
